from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# ==========================================
# CONSTANTS SECTION
# ==========================================

# Sec 16(ia) - Standard deduction (old regime)
STD_DED_OLD = Decimal("50000")

# Sec 16(ia) Proviso (Sec 115BAC) - Standard deduction (new regime)
STD_DED_NEW = Decimal("75000")

# Sec 24(b) - Max interest for self-occupied house property (old regime)
MAX_HP_INTEREST_OLD = Decimal("200000")

# Sec 71(3A) - Max house property loss set-off against salary (old regime)
MAX_HP_SET_OFF_OLD = Decimal("200000")

# Sec 80C - Max aggregate deduction (old regime)
SEC_80C_MAX = Decimal("150000")

# Sec 80CCD(1B) - Max additional NPS contribution (old regime)
SEC_80CCD_1B_MAX = Decimal("50000")

# Sec 80D - Health insurance caps (old regime)
SEC_80D_SELF_NON_SENIOR = Decimal("25000")
SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")
SEC_80D_PARENTS_NON_SENIOR = Decimal("25000")
SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A - Old regime tax slabs: (lower, upper_or_None, rate)
SLABS_OLD_BELOW_60 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("250000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("250000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]
SLABS_OLD_60_TO_79 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]
SLABS_OLD_80_PLUS = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 115BAC(1A)(iii) - New regime tax slabs (same for all ages)
SLABS_NEW = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("400000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("400000"), Decimal("800000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("800000"), Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("1600000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("1600000"), Decimal("2000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("2000000"), Decimal("2400000"), Decimal("0.25")),
    (Decimal("2400000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 87A - Rebate thresholds and limits
REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_OLD = Decimal("500000")
REBATE_MAX_OLD = Decimal("12500")
REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW = Decimal("1200000")
REBATE_MAX_NEW = Decimal("60000")

# First Schedule - Surcharge thresholds and rates
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_OLD = [
    (Decimal("5000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("10000000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("20000000"), Decimal("0.25")),
    (Decimal("50000000"), Decimal("0.37")),
]
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_NEW = [
    (Decimal("5000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("10000000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("20000000"), Decimal("0.25")),
]

# Health and Education Cess rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal("0.04")


def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> tuple[Decimal, Decimal]:
    """
    Sec 288A / 288B rounding:
    First floor to whole rupees (ignore paise), then round to the nearest multiple of 10
    where a last digit of 5 or more rounds UP.
    Returns (rounded_amount, adjustment_amount).
    """
    floored = amount.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    # To round to nearest 10: divide by 10, round half up, multiply by 10
    divided = floored / Decimal("10")
    rounded_div = divided.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    rounded = rounded_div * Decimal("10")
    adjustment = rounded - amount
    return rounded, adjustment


def compute_tax_for_income(taxable_income: Decimal, slabs: list[tuple[Decimal, Decimal | None, Decimal]]) -> tuple[Decimal, list[tuple[str, Decimal]]]:
    total_tax = Decimal("0")
    slab_details = []
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if upper is None:
            if taxable_income > lower:
                taxable_in_slab = taxable_income - lower
            else:
                taxable_in_slab = Decimal("0")
        else:
            if taxable_income > lower:
                taxable_in_slab = min(taxable_income, upper) - lower
            else:
                taxable_in_slab = Decimal("0")
        
        tax_in_slab = taxable_in_slab * rate
        total_tax += tax_in_slab
        
        if upper is None:
            desc = f"Tax on income above {lower}"
        else:
            desc = f"Tax on income between {lower} and {upper}"
        slab_details.append((desc, tax_in_slab))
        
    return total_tax, slab_details


def get_surcharge_rate(total_income: Decimal, thresholds: list[tuple[Decimal, Decimal]]) -> Decimal:
    rate = Decimal("0")
    for thresh, r in thresholds:
        if total_income > thresh:
            rate = r
    return rate


def calculate_regime_result(
    gross_salary: Decimal,
    age: int,
    hra_received: Decimal,
    basic_plus_da: Decimal,
    rent_paid: Decimal,
    rent_city_is_metro: bool,
    home_loan_interest: Decimal,
    sec_80c: Decimal,
    sec_80ccd_1b: Decimal,
    health_ins_self: Decimal,
    health_ins_parents: Decimal,
    parents_senior: bool,
    is_new_regime: bool
) -> dict:
    trace = []

    # 1. Salary / Gross Salary
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary under Sec 17(1)",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })

    current_income = gross_salary

    # 2. HRA Exemption (Old regime only)
    hra_exempt = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime and hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
        # (a) HRA actually received
        cond_a = hra_received
        # (b) rent actually paid in excess of 10% of salary
        ten_percent_salary = basic_plus_da * Decimal("0.10")
        cond_b = rent_paid - ten_percent_salary if rent_paid > ten_percent_salary else Decimal("0")
        # (c) 50% or 40% of salary
        pct = Decimal("0.50") if rent_city_is_metro else Decimal("0.40")
        cond_c = basic_plus_da * pct

        hra_exempt = min(cond_a, cond_b, cond_c)
        if hra_exempt < Decimal("0"):
            hra_exempt = Decimal("0")

        if hra_exempt > 0:
            current_income -= hra_exempt
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "HRA exemption",
                "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
                "clause": "Sec 10(13A) & Rule 2A"
            })

    # 3. Standard Deduction
    std_ded = min(gross_salary, STD_DED_NEW if is_new_regime else STD_DED_OLD)
    if std_ded > 0:
        current_income -= std_ded
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Standard deduction",
            "amount": str(-std_ded),
            "clause": "Sec 16(ia)"
        })

    # 4. House Property Income / Loss (Old regime only)
    hp_loss = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime:
        allowed_hp_interest = min(home_loan_interest, MAX_HP_INTEREST_OLD)
        if allowed_hp_interest > 0:
            hp_loss = min(allowed_hp_interest, MAX_HP_SET_OFF_OLD)
            if hp_loss > 0:
                current_income -= hp_loss
                trace.append({
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "House property loss set off against salary",
                    "amount": str(-hp_loss),
                    "clause": "Sec 24(b) & Sec 71(3A)"
                })

    gti = max(current_income, Decimal("0"))

    # 5. Chapter VI-A Deductions (Old regime only)
    ch_via_total = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime and gti > 0:
        # Sec 80C capped
        ded_80c = min(sec_80c, SEC_80C_MAX)
        if ded_80c > 0:
            ch_via_total += ded_80c
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Sec 80C",
                "amount": str(-ded_80c),
                "clause": "Sec 80C & Sec 80CCE"
            })

        # Sec 80CCD(1B)
        ded_80ccd = min(sec_80ccd_1b, SEC_80CCD_1B_MAX)
        if ded_80ccd > 0:
            ch_via_total += ded_80ccd
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Sec 80CCD(1B)",
                "amount": str(-ded_80ccd),
                "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"
            })

        # Sec 80D
        # Self, spouse, children
        self_cap = SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR if age >= 60 else SEC_80D_SELF_NON_SENIOR
        ded_80d_self = min(health_ins_self, self_cap)
        # Parents
        parents_cap = SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else SEC_80D_PARENTS_NON_SENIOR
        ded_80d_parents = min(health_ins_parents, parents_cap)
        ded_80d_total = ded_80d_self + ded_80d_parents
        if ded_80d_total > 0:
            ch_via_total += ded_80d_total
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Sec 80D for health insurance",
                "amount": str(-ded_80d_total),
                "clause": "Sec 80D"
            })

        # Overall cap Sec 80A(2): Chapter VI-A cannot exceed GTI
        if ch_via_total > gti:
            excess = ch_via_total - gti
            # Adjust trace or just cap GTI
            ch_via_total = gti

        current_income = gti - ch_via_total
    else:
        current_income = gti

    unrounded_total_income = max(current_income, Decimal("0"))

    # Sec 288A - Rounding of total income
    rounded_total_income, income_rounding_adj = round_nearest_ten(unrounded_total_income)
    if income_rounding_adj != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment to total income",
            "amount": str(income_rounding_adj),
            "clause": "Sec 288A"
        })

    # 6. Tax computation
    if is_new_regime:
        slabs = SLABS_NEW
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_80_PLUS
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_60_TO_79
        else:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_BELOW_60

    tax_before_rebate, slab_details = compute_tax_for_income(rounded_total_income, slabs)
    for desc, amt in slab_details:
        if amt > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": desc,
                "amount": str(amt),
                "clause": "First Schedule"
            })

    # 7. Sec 87A Rebate & Marginal Relief
    rebate = Decimal("0")
    if is_new_regime:
        if rounded_total_income <= REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW:
            rebate = min(tax_before_rebate, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
        else:
            # Marginal relief for new regime Sec 87A
            excess_income = rounded_total_income - REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW
            tax_at_limit, _ = compute_tax_for_income(REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW, slabs)
            rebate_at_limit = min(tax_at_limit, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
            tax_after_limit_rebate = tax_at_limit - rebate_at_limit
            max_allowed_tax = excess_income
            if tax_before_rebate > max_allowed_tax:
                # Excess tax over (total income - 12,00,000) is given as rebate relief
                # Specifically, tax_before_rebate - rebate <= max_allowed_tax => rebate >= tax_before_rebate - max_allowed_tax
                potential_rebate = tax_before_rebate - max_allowed_tax
                if potential_rebate > 0:
                    rebate = potential_rebate
    else:
        if rounded_total_income <= REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_OLD:
            rebate = min(tax_before_rebate, REBATE_MAX_OLD)

    if rebate > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rebate under Sec 87A",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A"
        })

    tax_after_rebate = max(tax_before_rebate - rebate, Decimal("0"))

    # 8. Surcharge and Surcharge Marginal Relief
    thresholds = SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_NEW if is_new_regime else SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_OLD
    surcharge_rate = get_surcharge_rate(rounded_total_income, thresholds)
    surcharge = tax_after_rebate * surcharge_rate

    if surcharge > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Surcharge",
            "amount": str(surcharge),
            "clause": "First Schedule"
        })

        # Check surcharge marginal relief
        # Find applicable threshold exceeded
        applied_threshold = None
        applied_threshold_rate = Decimal("0")
        for thresh, r in thresholds:
            if rounded_total_income > thresh:
                applied_threshold = thresh
                applied_threshold_rate = r

        if applied_threshold is not None:
            # Tax + Surcharge at rounded_total_income
            total_tax_surcharge = tax_after_rebate + surcharge

            # Tax + Surcharge at threshold
            tax_at_thresh, _ = compute_tax_for_income(applied_threshold, slabs)
            # Rebate at threshold if applicable
            rebate_thresh = Decimal("0")
            if is_new_regime and applied_threshold <= REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW:
                rebate_thresh = min(tax_at_thresh, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
            elif not is_new_regime and applied_threshold <= REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_OLD:
                rebate_thresh = min(tax_at_thresh, REBATE_MAX_OLD)
            tax_after_rebate_thresh = max(tax_at_thresh - rebate_thresh, Decimal("0"))
            surcharge_thresh = tax_after_rebate_thresh * applied_threshold_rate
            total_tax_surcharge_thresh = tax_after_rebate_thresh + surcharge_thresh

            excess_income_over_thresh = rounded_total_income - applied_threshold
            max_allowed_total = total_tax_surcharge_thresh + excess_income_over_thresh

            if total_tax_surcharge > max_allowed_total:
                surcharge_marginal_relief = total_tax_surcharge - max_allowed_total
                if surcharge_marginal_relief > 0:
                    surcharge -= surcharge_marginal_relief
                    trace.append({
                        "kind": "tax",
                        "description": "Surcharge marginal relief",
                        "amount": str(-surcharge_marginal_relief),
                        "clause": "First Schedule"
                    })

    tax_plus_surcharge = tax_after_rebate + surcharge

    # 9. Health and Education Cess
    cess = tax_plus_surcharge * CESS_RATE
    if cess > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and Education Cess",
            "amount": str(cess),
            "clause": "Finance Act"
        })

    total_tax_unrounded = tax_plus_surcharge + cess

    # 10. Sec 288B - Rounding of tax
    final_tax_payable, tax_rounding_adj = round_nearest_ten(total_tax_unrounded)
    if tax_rounding_adj != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment to tax payable",
            "amount": str(tax_rounding_adj),
            "clause": "Sec 288B"
        })

    return {
        "total_income": int(rounded_total_income),
        "tax_payable": int(final_tax_payable),
        "trace": trace
    }


def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp.get("gross_salary", 0)))
    age = int(inp.get("age", 0))
    hra_received = Decimal(str(inp.get("hra_received", 0)))
    basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp.get("basic_plus_da", 0)))
    rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp.get("rent_paid", 0)))
    rent_city_is_metro = bool(inp.get("rent_city_is_metro", False))
    home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp.get("home_loan_interest", 0)))
    sec_80c = Decimal(str(inp.get("sec_80c", 0)))
    sec_80ccd_1b = Decimal(str(inp.get("sec_80ccd_1b", 0)))
    health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp.get("health_ins_self", 0)))
    health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp.get("health_ins_parents", 0)))
    parents_senior = bool(inp.get("parents_senior", False))

    old_result = calculate_regime_result(
        gross_salary, age, hra_received, basic_plus_da, rent_paid,
        rent_city_is_metro, home_loan_interest, sec_80c, sec_80ccd_1b,
        health_ins_self, health_ins_parents, parents_senior, is_new_regime=False
    )

    new_result = calculate_regime_result(
        gross_salary, age, hra_received, basic_plus_da, rent_paid,
        rent_city_is_metro, home_loan_interest, sec_80c, sec_80ccd_1b,
        health_ins_self, health_ins_parents, parents_senior, is_new_regime=True
    )

    return {
        "old": old_result,
        "new": new_result
    }
